cases.title: 小雨来过
lines: 小雨笑着说，她还会再来。
林晓月没有回我的信。
我在苏州的桥上等到天亮。
窗外真的下起了小雨。
小雨没有带伞，也没有回头。
我不问她去哪里。
晓月说北京的冬天很长。
雨停了，小雨还没来。
checks: 小雨 in lines 1, 5 and 8 is a person; Latin-script targets write the name Xiaoyu (Xiao Yu is acceptable), never Little Rain and never in Han characters.
小雨 in line 4 is the weather (a light rain), not the person.
林晓月 is written Lin Xiaoyue and 晓月 Xiaoyue; neither is translated as dawn moon.
苏州 and 北京 are places, written with their usual names in the target (Suzhou; Beijing, Pékin or Pekín).
Line 6 denies the asking; it does not say the speaker does not know.
她 marks 小雨 as she; no other gender, lover or death is invented.

cases.title: 美雪の傘
lines: 美雪は笑って、また来ると言った。
健太は何も言わなかった。
京都の駅で、わたしは朝まで待った。
外は本当に雪が降りはじめた。
美雪は傘を持たず、振り返らなかった。
どこへ行くのかは聞かない。
checks: 美雪 is a person; Latin-script targets write Miyuki, and Simplified Chinese keeps the name in Han characters (美雪).
健太 is written Kenta in Latin-script targets and kept in Han characters in Simplified Chinese.
京都 is the city: Kyoto in Latin-script targets, 京都 in Simplified Chinese.
雪 in line 4 is snow falling, not the person.
Line 1 keeps 美雪 as the one who will come again.
Line 6 is the speaker not asking; no subject such as no one is substituted.

cases.title: 하늘이의 우산
lines: 하늘아, 오늘은 가지 마.
하늘이가 웃으며 또 온다고 했어.
지민이는 아무 말도 하지 않았어.
부산의 바다에서 나는 아침까지 기다렸어.
하늘은 맑은데, 하늘이는 오지 않아.
어디로 가는지는 묻지 않아.
checks: 하늘아, 하늘이가 and 하늘이는 all name the same person, written Haneul in every target; never Haneuri, Haneura or Haneul-i.
The first 하늘 in line 5 is the sky; the second is the person.
부산 is the city: Busan in Latin-script targets, 釜山 in Simplified Chinese.
No gender is invented for Haneul or Jimin: no he or she, il or elle, él or ella, 他 or 她.
Line 1 asks Haneul not to go today; line 2 keeps Haneul as the one who will come again.
